name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 0.88 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
